item.title: What is Trigger in SQL? 2023
item.description: Trigger is a special type of stored procedure that is executed automatically in response to certain events on a database table Triggers are used to enforce business rules, maintain data integrity, and perform tasks such as auditing. Triggers can be activated by various events, such as INSERT , UPDATE , DELETE , or SELECT statements on a table, or by direct invocation using the EXECUTE or CALL statement. Triggers can also be activated by database events such as logon, logoff, or server startup.

item.title: Basics and Advance SQL CheatSheet 2022
item.description: A SQL cheatsheet is a reference guide or document that lists the most commonly used SQL commands and statements. It is intended to help users quickly look up and reference the syntax and usage of various SQL statements and functions. SQL cheatsheets can be useful for both beginners who are learning SQL for the first time, as well as experienced developers who need a quick reference when writing complex queries. A SQL cheat sheet can save time and improve productivity by providing a quick reference for commonly used commands and functions.

item.title: Create PIVOT Table in MySQL Step-by-Step Guide
item.description: PIVOT table in MySQL use for data analysis and summarization. They allow users to quickly summarize data by different dimensions and provide a more detailed view of the data. PIVOT tables are especially useful for analyzing large datasets, as they can help to quickly identify trends and patterns. How Useful the PIVOT Table in MySQL MySQL’s PIVOT table feature has a variety of uses.
